description: List the users of the company, such as recruiters and hiring managers, with name, email and system role. SmartRecruiters: GET /users.

description: Search candidates who have at least one job application, by keyword, job, status, tag or update time. Returns content, totalFound and nextPageId. Call one page at a time: this endpoint allows one concurrent request. SmartRecruiters: GET /candidates.

jobId.description: Only candidates who applied for this job id.

pageId.description: Pass the nextPageId from the previous reply to read the next page. Omit for the first page.

status.description: Candidate status in the context of a job, e.g. NEW, IN_REVIEW, INTERVIEW, OFFERED, HIRED.

tag.description: Only candidates with this tag, case insensitive.

updatedAfter.description: Only items updated after this time, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z.

name: smartrecruiters_search_candidates
title: Search candidates

description: Search the company's job requisitions by keyword, status, city, department or update time. Returns content with each job, totalFound and nextPageId. SmartRecruiters: GET /jobs.

city.description: City filter, case sensitive, e.g. San Francisco.

department.description: Department label filter, case sensitive, e.g. Marketing.

pageId.description: Pass the nextPageId from the previous reply to read the next page. Omit for the first page.

q.description: Keyword to match in the job title, e.g. java developer.

updatedAfter.description: Only items updated after this time, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z.
